SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Eligible Free Rate"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools."CDSCode"
WHERE schools."SOCType" = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY "Eligible Free Rate" ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT T2.MailStreet
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T1.OpenDate > '2000/1/1'

WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 AND schools.Virtual = 'F';

FROM satscores AS T1

LIMIT 1

WHERE frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (

);

FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`

ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds

LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.School, s.NCESSchool, f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda'

SELECT satscores.sname, schools.CharterNum, satscores.AvgScrWrite

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Fresno'

SELECT T2.Phone

LIMIT 1;

SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.OpenDate

SELECT schools.City

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT sc.School,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT T2.EILName
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

LIMIT 1

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY (AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) ASC
LIMIT 1;

FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.sname, satscores.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

SELECT District FROM schools WHERE City = 'Fresno' AND Magnet = 0

JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

       T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.County, COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS NumSchools
FROM schools AS T1
WHERE T1.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND T1.Virtual = 'F'

ORDER BY NumSchools DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.School, T2.Latitude, T1.`School Type` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T2.Latitude DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, s.GSserved, s.School
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8' 
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' 
GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT first_name, district
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District AS district FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
) AS administrators
WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY first_name, district
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT frpm.`District Code`,
       frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND StatusType = 'Public'
  AND (AdmEmail1 LIKE '%@%' OR AdmEmail2 LIKE '%@%' OR AdmEmail3 LIKE '%@%');

SELECT sch.AdmEmail1, sat.sname

      SELECT MAX(Reputation)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'

SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users WHERE Upvotes > 100 AND Downvotes > 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)

FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName

FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

FROM posts p

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount

WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT b.Name

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total_consumption) AS total,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT total * 1.0 / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

  (
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
     JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')

    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
     JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

   FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
   JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

FROM district;

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

JOIN disp d ON t1.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id
WHERE t1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY t1.birth_date ASC, t2.A11 ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers

JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c

JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.account_id

WHERE l.status = 'A'

  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(amount)
      FROM loan

        AND date LIKE '97%'
  );

SELECT l.account_id

ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)

JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id

);

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c

WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date AS account_open_date

SELECT a.district_id

SELECT c.gender

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)

        ORDER BY l.amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.client_id)

JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id

SELECT d.disp_id

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT c.birth_date

JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

SELECT a.account_id

    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'

SELECT (
    (SELECT balance
     FROM trans
     WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id
                         FROM loan
                         WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
                         ORDER BY loan_id
                         LIMIT 1)
       AND date = '1998-12-27')
    -
    (SELECT balance
     FROM trans
     WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id
                         FROM loan
                         WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
                         ORDER BY loan_id
                         LIMIT 1)
       AND date = '1993-03-22')

(
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id
                        FROM loan
                        WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
                        ORDER BY loan_id
                        LIMIT 1)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2, district.A3
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id,

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

      SELECT 1

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
) T
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((T.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0) OR (T.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

SELECT element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '-'
        GROUP BY a2.element
    ) t
);

JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT frpm.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`County Name` = 'Amador'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
  AND frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
  AND NumTstTakr = (
      SELECT MAX(NumTstTakr)
      FROM satscores
      WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
  );

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT sch.School
FROM schools sch
JOIN frpm f ON sch.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores st ON st.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND st.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT T1.sname, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.sname, T2.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T1.School, T2.AvgScrWrite, T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT s.School, s.DOC
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS f2
      INNER JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT schools.School, schools.Website
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
JOIN schools AS s ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sch.AdmFName1, sch.AdmLName1, sch.AdmFName2, sch.AdmLName2, sch.AdmFName3, sch.AdmLName3
FROM schools sch
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores);

SELECT schools.Street, schools.City, schools.Zip, schools.State
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode

LIMIT 1

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT sa.sname,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.Virtual = 'F'
) t
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT s.EILName
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode

SELECT s.AvgScrMath, sc.County
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = t.cds
JOIN (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) AS max_ge FROM satscores) mx ON t.NumGE1500 = mx.max_ge;

SELECT sc.School, st.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS sc
JOIN satscores AS st ON st.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE (sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s.DOC = '52'
  AND strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.DOC = 54 THEN s.CDSCode END) AS REAL) /
       NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.DOC = 52 THEN s.CDSCode END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools s
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CDSCode FROM frpm) f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND s.County = 'Orange';

SELECT s.School, s.ClosedDate
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY County
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top_county ON s.County = top_county.County
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed';

SELECT schools.School AS School_Name, schools.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode

SELECT schools.MailStreet, satscores.sname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sc ON st.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE (st.AvgScrRead + st.AvgScrMath + st.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr)

SELECT s.School, s.MailZip

      FROM schools

JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

SELECT s.GSserved
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Adelanto'

SELECT s.County, COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.School, s.Latitude, f."School Type"

SELECT s.City, f.`Low Grade`, s.School

SELECT s.GSoffered

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*)

JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT t.first_name, s.District, COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, AdmFName1 AS first_name FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
) t ON s.CDSCode = t.CDSCode
GROUP BY t.first_name, s.District
ORDER BY name_count DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'SME' THEN a.avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'LAM' THEN a.avg_c END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'LAM' THEN a.avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'KAM' THEN a.avg_c END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'KAM' THEN a.avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'SME' THEN a.avg_c END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_c
    FROM (
        SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
        FROM customers c
        JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
    ) t
    JOIN (
        SELECT x.Segment, MIN(x.total) AS min_total
        FROM (
            SELECT c2.CustomerID, c2.Segment, SUM(y2.Consumption) AS total
            FROM customers c2
            JOIN yearmonth y2 ON y2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
            WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND y2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            GROUP BY c2.CustomerID, c2.Segment
        ) x
        GROUP BY x.Segment
    ) m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
) a;

WITH seg_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT 'Biggest' AS Type, segment, pct_increase
FROM (SELECT segment, pct_increase FROM seg_pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Lowest' AS Type, segment, pct_increase
FROM (SELECT segment, pct_increase FROM seg_pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1);

SELECT COUNT(M.id)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', M.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.home_team_goal = 10;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN (SELECT MAX(balance) AS max_balance FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = 61) MB
  ON PA.balance = MB.max_balance
WHERE PA.potential = 61;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END)
  -
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END) AS difference
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'GEN';

SELECT p1.player_name AS older_player
FROM Player p1
JOIN Player p2 ON p1.birthday < p2.birthday
WHERE p1.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
  AND p2.player_name = 'Abdelaziz Barrada';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN (SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height FROM Player) m
  ON p.height = m.max_height;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes pa 
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left' AND pa.attacking_work_rate = 'low';

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Germany';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'
  AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.volleys > 70 AND PA.dribbling > 70;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Match.season = '2008/2009' AND Country.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT pa.long_passing
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC, pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(Match.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(PA.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(PA.id) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT (TA.overall_rating - TB.overall_rating) * 100.0 / TB.overall_rating AS percentage_higher
FROM Player PA
JOIN Player_Attributes TA ON TA.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN Player PB
JOIN Player_Attributes TB ON TB.player_api_id = PB.player_api_id
WHERE PA.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
  AND PB.player_name = 'Paulin Puel';

SELECT AVG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS avg_build_up_play_speed
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian';
SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T2 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T2.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'
SELECT SUM(T1.crossing) AS total_crossing_score FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennox'

SELECT MAX(TA.chanceCreationPassing) AS chanceCreationPassing, TA.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
GROUP BY TA.chanceCreationPassingClass
ORDER BY MAX(TA.chanceCreationPassing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.preferred_foot
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';
SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

SELECT AVG(m.away_team_goal) AS average_away_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Parma'
  AND c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND Player_Attributes.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT Player_Attributes.potential
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
  AND Player_Attributes.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND Player_Attributes.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT PA.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND PA.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes pa2
      JOIN Player p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
      WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND TA.date = '2012-02-22';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'LEI'
  AND ta.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle'
  AND Team_Attributes.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT ta.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND ta.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT
  (
    (SELECT overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan')
       AND date = '2013-07-12')
    -
    (SELECT overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')
       AND date = '2013-07-12')
  ) * 100.0
  /
  (SELECT overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes
   WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan')
     AND date = '2013-07-12');

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN (SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height FROM Player) AS M
  ON P.height = M.max_height;

SELECT T1.player_api_id
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
GROUP BY T1.player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(T1.weight) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
LEFT JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - datetime(P.birthday) > 34;

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Player AS P ON M.home_player_1 = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(t.away_team_goal)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.away_team_goal
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
                             m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10,
                             m.away_player_11)
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')
) t;

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Player AS P
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4,
                         M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8,
                         M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11)
WHERE (JULIANDAY(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime')) - JULIANDAY(datetime(P.birthday))) / 365.25 < 31;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(T2.birthday)) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
JOIN Player P ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name,
    c.name AS country
FROM Player p, Country c
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
        SELECT pa.player_api_id
        FROM Player_Attributes pa
        WHERE pa.vision > 89
      )
  AND c.id IN (
        SELECT m.country_id
        FROM Match m
        WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
            m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
            m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
            m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
            m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
        )
      );

SELECT c.name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(DISTINCT P.height)
FROM Country C
JOIN Match M ON C.id = M.country_id
JOIN Player P ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height > 180
ORDER BY T1.player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND p.birthday > '1990';

SELECT p.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY pa.potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND PA.crossing = (SELECT MAX(PA2.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes PA2);

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS games_played
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT MAX(m.home_team_goal) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT l.name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND l.loan_id IS NULL;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN AVG(d.A12) > AVG(d.A13) THEN '1995'
         ELSE '1996'
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district d
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM account) a
  ON a.district_id = d.district_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district
JOIN client ON district.district_id = client.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND district.A11 > 6000
  AND district.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.A11) FROM district d2) - d1.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d1 ON d1.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2 WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND d1.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d3.A11) FROM district d3);

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
JOIN (SELECT MAX(birth_date) AS youngest_birth_date FROM client) y
  ON c.birth_date = y.youngest_birth_date
JOIN (SELECT MAX(A11) AS max_salary FROM district) s
  ON di.A11 = s.max_salary;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'Owner'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND l.date LIKE '97%'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND (a.date LIKE '1993%' OR a.date LIKE '93%')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND di.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN (
    SELECT MIN(date) AS earliest_date
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
) m ON t.date = m.earliest_date;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.amount > 3000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM card ca
JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE ca.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district t ON a.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE t.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM disp d
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996;

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS in_patient_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS outpatient_count,
       CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS REAL)
           / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M';

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cf.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(cf.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 cf
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cf.Segment = m.Segment AND cf.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cf.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_change
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Biggest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Lowest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'

FROM Patient AS T1

JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

LIMIT 1

JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID

INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
          / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)

FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond INNER JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT atom.molecule_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' AND element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT M.molecule_id, M.label, MAX(CASE WHEN A.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS element
    FROM molecule M
    JOIN atom A ON A.molecule_id = M.molecule_id
    GROUP BY M.molecule_id, M.label
);
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
SELECT T1.bond_type FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE (T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2') OR (T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1')
SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4');
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage FROM bond;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'n' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T5.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T5.molecule_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010' AND bond_type = '-'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = 'TR008' AND a.element = 'c'
SELECT atom.element FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = '='
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '-'
SELECT T1.element, T2.bond_type FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id WHERE T4.label = 'TR012' AND T1.element = 'c' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District AS district
    FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS name_count
    FROM admin_names
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(first_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY name_count DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT a.first_name, a.district
FROM admin_names a
JOIN name_counts nc ON a.first_name = nc.first_name
GROUP BY a.first_name, a.district, nc.name_count

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
cons AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM czk)
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(t.total) AS min_total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, t.total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN seg_min m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct_increase AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_increase
    FROM eur_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct_increase
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND (
      percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))
      OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN PA.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN PA.id ELSE NULL END)
  -
  SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN PA.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN PA.id ELSE NULL END) AS ball_control_diff

SELECT p.player_name

      SELECT MIN(p2.birthday)
      FROM Player p2

SELECT COUNT(T1.id)

SELECT c.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT l.name

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count

SELECT PA.long_passing
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id

LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM League AS L JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id

SELECT CAST(SUM(Player_Attributes.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.id) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel');

SELECT AVG(TA.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS average_build_up_play_speed
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id
WHERE T.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT SUM(T1.crossing) AS total_crossing_score
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating

WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT AVG(m.away_team_goal) AS average_away_goals

SELECT P.player_name

JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id

SELECT pa.overall_rating

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate

SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass

SELECT ta.chanceCreationPassingClass

SELECT ta.chanceCreationCrossingClass

SELECT CAST(LD.overall_rating - JB.overall_rating AS REAL) * 100 / LD.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM
  (SELECT overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes
   WHERE player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan')
     AND date LIKE '2013-07-12%') LD,
  (SELECT overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes
   WHERE player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')
     AND date LIKE '2013-07-12%') JB;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10;

 AND (m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id

   OR m.home_player_5 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_6 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_7 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_8 = p.player_api_id

    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,

JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

    UNION ALL

SELECT c.name AS country_name, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
FROM player_country pc
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pc.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pc.pid
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(DISTINCT p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,

    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,

SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';

JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON pa1.id <> pa2.id

JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(pa.potential) ASC

SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass

FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)

FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
         ELSE '1996'
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - di.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
                FROM client c2
                JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
                WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                  AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'));

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM client c

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_early AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_late AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ((SELECT balance FROM bal_late) - (SELECT balance FROM bal_early)) * 100.0
    / (SELECT balance FROM bal_early) AS increase_rate;

  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS double_bond_molecules,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_double_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom a
        WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND a.element = 's'
      )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND b.bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS num_elements
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element AS element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
    UNION
    SELECT a2.element AS element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
) t;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1');

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE a.element = 'n' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.molecule_id) > 5

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR024'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a1.element = 'h'
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.element = 'h'
    JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id AND c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id AND b.bond_type = '#'
) t;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR008' AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND (a1.element = 'o' OR a2.element = 'o');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = 'TR012';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'o';
